title: Spec of a ring map is etale iff the ring map is etale (finitely presented with H_1 = 0 and Omega = 0)
statement: Let $\varphi:R\to S$ be a homomorphism of commutative rings and $\operatorname{Spec}\varphi:\operatorname{Spec}S\to\operatorname{Spec}R$ the induced morphism of affine schemes [def-weil-affine-spectrum]. Then $\operatorname{Spec}\varphi$ is étale [def-weil-etale-morphism] if and only if $\varphi$ is an étale ring map in the sense of Algebra, Definition 00U1: $S$ is a finitely presented $R$-algebra, $H_1(L_{S/R})=0$ [def-weil-pbc-smooth-ring-map] and $\Omega_{S/R}=0$ [def-weil-pbc-kahler-differentials].
